<script type="module">
  var toggleDark = document.getElementById("toggleDark");
  var slider = document.querySelector(".slider");

  function toggleDarkMode() {
    console.log("Dark mode toggled");
    toggleDark.checked = !toggleDark.checked;

    if (toggleDark.checked) {
      document.documentElement.classList.add("dark-mode");
      localStorage.setItem("darkMode", true);
      window.Capacitor?.Plugins?.SystemBars?.setStyle({ style: 'DARK' });
    } else {
      document.documentElement.classList.remove("dark-mode");
      localStorage.setItem("darkMode", false);
      window.Capacitor?.Plugins?.SystemBars?.setStyle({ style: 'LIGHT' });
    }
  }

  slider.addEventListener(
    "mousedown",
    (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      toggleDarkMode();
    },
    { passive: false },
  );
  slider.addEventListener(
    "touchstart",
    (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      toggleDarkMode();
    },
    { passive: false },
  );

  slider.addEventListener("touchend", (e) => e.preventDefault(), {
    passive: false,
  });
  slider.addEventListener("click", (e) => e.preventDefault(), {
    passive: false,
  });
</script>

  let activeQuestion = null;
  let questions = document.querySelectorAll(".question");

  for (const question of questions) {
    question.onclick = (e) => {
      let answer = question.nextElementSibling;

      if (activeQuestion && activeQuestion !== question) {
        activeQuestion.classList.remove("active");
        activeQuestion.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
        activeQuestion.nextElementSibling.style.maxHeight = null;
      }

      question.classList.toggle("active");

      if (question.classList.contains("active")) {
        answer.style.maxHeight = answer.scrollHeight + "px";
        question.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
        activeQuestion = question; 
      } else {
        answer.style.maxHeight = null;
        question.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
        activeQuestion = null; 
      }
    };
  }

  const interestBox = document.getElementById("interestBox");
  const interestInfo = document.querySelector(".interestInfo");
  const interestContainer = document.getElementById("interestContainer");
  const interestsEnter = document.querySelector(".interestsEnter");
  const textBtn = document.getElementById("textBtn");
  const videoBtn = document.getElementById("videoBtn");
  const ageToggle = document.getElementById("ageToggle");
  const openAgreementLink = document.getElementById("openAgreementLink");
  const agreementModal = document.getElementById("agreementModal");
  const closeAgreementBtn = document.getElementById("closeAgreementBtn");

  interestContainer.addEventListener("click", () => {
    if (ageToggle.checked) interestBox.focus();
  });

  function updateInterestInfoVisibility() {
    const interests = document.querySelectorAll(".interestTag");
    interestInfo.style.display =
      interests.length === 0 && !interestBox.value ? "flex" : "none";
  }

  function saveInterests() {
    const interests = Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll(".interestWord"),
      (tag) => tag.textContent.trim(),
    );
    localStorage.setItem("interests", JSON.stringify(interests));
  }

  function onInputHandler(event) {
    updateInterestInfoVisibility();

    let value = interestBox.value.toLowerCase();
    const lastChar = value.slice(-1);
    const isComma = lastChar === "," || lastChar === " ";
    const isEnterOrSpace =
      event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " " || event.keyCode === 13;

    if (event.key == "Backspace") {
      const interests = document.querySelectorAll(".interestTag");
      if (interests.length > 0 && interestBox.value == "") {
        interests[interests.length - 1].remove();
        saveInterests();
      }

      updateInterestInfoVisibility();
      return;
    }

    if (isComma || isEnterOrSpace || event.code == "Space") {
      event.preventDefault();
      value = isComma ? value.slice(0, -1).trim() : value.trim();
      if (value) addInterestToUI(value);
      interestBox.value = "";
      saveInterests();
    }
  }

  function cementInterests() {
    let value = interestBox.value.toLowerCase().trim();
    if (value) addInterestToUI(value);
    interestBox.value = "";
    saveInterests();
  }

  document.onclick = (e) => {
    cementInterests();
  };

  window.addEventListener("beforeunload", () => {
    cementInterests();
  });

  window.onInputHandler = onInputHandler;

  interestBox.addEventListener("keydown", onInputHandler);
  interestBox.addEventListener("input", onInputHandler);

  function addInterestToUI(interest) {
    const existingInterests = Array.from(
      document.querySelectorAll(".interestWord"),
      (tag) => tag.textContent,
    );
    if (existingInterests.includes(interest)) return;

    const interestTag = document.createElement("div");
    interestTag.className = "interestTag";
    interestTag.innerHTML = `<div class='interestWord'>${interest}</div><div class='removeInterest'>×</div>`;

    interestTag.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      if (!ageToggle.checked) return;
      interestTag.remove();
      saveInterests();
      updateInterestInfoVisibility();
    });

    interestsEnter.insertBefore(interestTag, interestBox);
    updateInterestInfoVisibility();
  }

  var interests = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("interests"));
  interests ? interests.forEach((e) => addInterestToUI(e)) : "";

  function updateAgreementState() {
    const isChecked = ageToggle.checked;
    interestBox.disabled = !isChecked;
    textBtn.classList.toggle("disabled", !isChecked);
    videoBtn.classList.toggle("disabled", !isChecked);
    interestContainer.classList.toggle("disabled", !isChecked);
  }

  function handleChatClick(e, targetPath) {
    if (!ageToggle.checked) {
      e.preventDefault();
      return;
    }
    cementInterests();
    const currentInterests = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("interests")) || [];
    if (currentInterests.includes("testmode")) {
      e.preventDefault();
      window.location.href = "https://test.umingle.com" + targetPath;
    }
  }

  textBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => handleChatClick(e, "/text/"));
  videoBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => handleChatClick(e, "/video/"));
  ageToggle.addEventListener("change", updateAgreementState);
  updateAgreementState();

  openAgreementLink.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    agreementModal.classList.add("open");
  });

  closeAgreementBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
    agreementModal.classList.remove("open");
  });

  agreementModal.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
    if (e.target === agreementModal) {
      agreementModal.classList.remove("open");
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
    if (e.key === "Escape" && agreementModal.classList.contains("open")) {
      agreementModal.classList.remove("open");
    }
  });

  var toggleDark = document.getElementById("toggleDark");

    console.log("Dark mode toggled");

      document.documentElement.classList.add("dark-mode");
      localStorage.setItem("darkMode", true);

      document.documentElement.classList.remove("dark-mode");
      localStorage.setItem("darkMode", false);
      window.Capacitor?.Plugins?.SystemBars?.setStyle({ style: 'LIGHT' });
    }
  }

  slider.addEventListener(
    "mousedown",
    (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      toggleDarkMode();
    },
    { passive: false },
  );
